reviewPolicy.sourcePolicy: Use the explicit Quantity example for the stated 0.05 value and two assumed decimal places; keep Segment 102 and Segment 157 chains separate.
reviewPolicy.dataPolicy: The four vectors are field-level design fragments, not complete product-data segment fixtures. Product context, Unit of Measure semantics, surrounding fields, and wire separators remain review gates.
reviewPolicy.baselinePolicy: References SEG102-R-012 and the Quantity component within SEG157-R-009; no official Test record is modified.
reviewPolicy.promotionGate: Authorized Test review must confirm applicable product contexts, decimal-place source, full segment rendering, and readiness before promotion or execution.

requirementReferences.title: Quantity preserves the assumed-decimal-place leading digit
Adjusted Product Code Segment field layout, including Quantity decimal-place encoding
requirementReferences.scopeNote: Composite candidate; this draft addresses only its Quantity sub-obligation.

sourceEvidence.quote: Quantity value must contain a digit for every position of assumed decimal places. Example: If the quantity is 0.05 and the number of assumed decimal places is 2, then this should be represented as ‘205’. ‘25’ will be considered invalid.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: The source explicitly identifies 205 as the representation for quantity 0.05 at two assumed decimal places and says 25 is invalid.

sourceEvidence.quote: Quantity value must contain a digit for every position of assumed decimal places. Example: If the quantity is 0.05 and the number of assumed decimal places is 2, then this should be represented as ‘205’. ‘25’ will be considered invalid.
sourceEvidence.interpretation: The same explicit representation example appears in the Adjusted Product Code Data Segment's Quantity field.

aiReviewReferences.screenedCaseObservation: All eight candidate payloads place Element 81 Quantity in Segment 102 and set it to 01; none places Quantity in Segment 157. Each candidate copy is hash-verified in the bounded screen, but full payload/sidecar review was not performed.
aiReviewReferences.interpretation: The Segment 102 cases do not state the assumed decimal-place count or a source-grounded quantity value, so their 01 values cannot be adjudicated as valid or invalid from the field observation alone. The Segment 157-linked cases have a segment-scope mismatch because the observed Quantity is in Segment 102.

testScenarios.intent: For the source example quantity 0.05 with two assumed decimal places, verify the Segment 102 Element 81 encoding; compare the explicitly valid and invalid encodings.
For the source example quantity 0.05 with two assumed decimal places, verify the Segment 157 Element 81 encoding in an otherwise valid Adjusted Product Code Data Segment.

testCases.assertion: For 0.05 with two assumed decimal places, Element 81 is represented as 205.
For 0.05 with two assumed decimal places, Element 81 value 25 is invalid because it omits a required position.
For 0.05 with two assumed decimal places, Segment 157 Element 81 is represented as 205.
For 0.05 with two assumed decimal places, Segment 157 Element 81 value 25 is invalid because it omits a required position.
